3552 noseo {nos-eh'-o}

from 3554; TDNT - 4:1091,655; v

AV - dote 1; 1

1) to be sick
2) metaph. of any ailment of the mind
   2a) to be taken with such an interest in a thing as amounts to a
       disease, to have a morbid fondness for
